mapper.sql: SELECT r.id AS id, r.order_no AS orderNo, r.instrument_id AS instrumentId, r.student_id AS studentId, r.start_date AS startDate, r.end_date AS endDate, r.deposit AS deposit, r.daily_rent AS dailyRent, r.rent_amount AS rentAmount, r.status AS status, r.return_date AS returnDate, r.overdue_fee AS overdueFee, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, i.instrument_no AS instrumentNo, i.name AS instrumentName, i.category AS instrumentCategory, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.name AS studentName FROM rental_order r LEFT JOIN instrument i ON i.id = r.instrument_id LEFT JOIN student s ON s.id = r.student_id
